description: Rewrite the share-count instruction to give concrete calibration guidance: when the materials affirmatively signal a likely event (authorized reverse split, disclosed ATM, explicit dilution warning) the base probability should be 0.75–0.95, not 0.3–0.5; reserve 0.15–0.35 for cases where only general distress is present with no specific signal. [round 3, Probability calibration too low for likely share-count events]
